skill_candidate_reviewed_chk.name: skill_candidate_reviewed_chk
skill_candidate_reviewed_chk.value:
"skill_candidate"."status" NOT IN ('approved_create', 'approved_map', 'approved_merge', 'rejected', 'deferred')
           OR ("skill_candidate"."reviewer_admin_id" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_candidate"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_candidate"."review_reason" IS NOT NULL)

skill_candidate_resolution_chk.name: skill_candidate_resolution_chk
skill_candidate_resolution_chk.value: "skill_candidate"."status" NOT IN ('approved_map', 'approved_merge') OR "skill_candidate"."resulting_skill_id" IS NOT NULL

pfb_exactly_one_target_chk.name: pfb_exactly_one_target_chk
pfb_exactly_one_target_chk.value:
(
        (CASE WHEN "profiling_family_binding"."job_domain_id"       IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN "profiling_family_binding"."isco_unit_code"      IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN "profiling_family_binding"."isco_minor_code"     IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN "profiling_family_binding"."isco_submajor_code"  IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN "profiling_family_binding"."isco_major_code"     IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN "profiling_family_binding"."is_universal"       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      ) = 1

pfb_specificity_matches_target_chk.name: pfb_specificity_matches_target_chk
pfb_specificity_matches_target_chk.value:
(
        ("profiling_family_binding"."job_domain_id"      IS NOT NULL AND "profiling_family_binding"."specificity" = 50) OR
        ("profiling_family_binding"."isco_unit_code"     IS NOT NULL AND "profiling_family_binding"."specificity" = 40) OR
        ("profiling_family_binding"."isco_minor_code"    IS NOT NULL AND "profiling_family_binding"."specificity" = 30) OR
        ("profiling_family_binding"."isco_submajor_code" IS NOT NULL AND "profiling_family_binding"."specificity" = 20) OR
        ("profiling_family_binding"."isco_major_code"    IS NOT NULL AND "profiling_family_binding"."specificity" = 10) OR
        ("profiling_family_binding"."is_universal"      AND "profiling_family_binding"."specificity" = 0)
      )

qpi_target_present_chk.name: qpi_target_present_chk
qpi_target_present_chk.value:
(
        ("question_pack_item"."target_kind" = 'none') OR
        ("question_pack_item"."target_kind" = 'match_skill' AND "question_pack_item"."target_skill_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("question_pack_item"."target_kind" IN ('rfs', 'attribute') AND "question_pack_item"."target_field" IS NOT NULL)
      )

qpi_turn_window_chk.name: qpi_turn_window_chk
qpi_turn_window_chk.value: "question_pack_item"."min_turn" IS NULL OR "question_pack_item"."max_turn" IS NULL OR "question_pack_item"."min_turn" <= "question_pack_item"."max_turn"

chat_sessions_pack_pin_chk.name: chat_sessions_pack_pin_chk
chat_sessions_pack_pin_chk.value: ("chat_sessions"."pack_id" IS NULL AND "chat_sessions"."pack_version" IS NULL) OR ("chat_sessions"."pack_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_sessions"."pack_version" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_sessions"."pack_version" >= 1)

wpa_answer_shape_chk.name: wpa_answer_shape_chk
wpa_answer_shape_chk.value:
("worker_pack_answer"."status" = 'answered') = (
        ("worker_pack_answer"."answer_text" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("worker_pack_answer"."answer_number" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("worker_pack_answer"."answer_bool" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("worker_pack_answer"."answer_option_keys" IS NOT NULL)::int
        = 1
      )

pva_superseded_pair_chk.name: pva_superseded_pair_chk
pva_superseded_pair_chk.value: ("profiling_voice_answer"."superseded_at" IS NULL AND "profiling_voice_answer"."superseded_by_id" IS NULL) OR ("profiling_voice_answer"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "profiling_voice_answer"."superseded_by_id" IS NOT NULL)

wa_value_present_chk.name: wa_value_present_chk
wa_value_present_chk.value:
(
        ("worker_attributes"."value_kind" = 'boolean'   AND "worker_attributes"."value_bool" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_attributes"."value_number" IS NULL AND "worker_attributes"."value_text" IS NULL AND "worker_attributes"."value_text_list" IS NULL) OR
        ("worker_attributes"."value_kind" = 'number'    AND "worker_attributes"."value_number" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_attributes"."value_bool" IS NULL AND "worker_attributes"."value_text" IS NULL AND "worker_attributes"."value_text_list" IS NULL) OR
        ("worker_attributes"."value_kind" = 'text'      AND "worker_attributes"."value_text" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_attributes"."value_bool" IS NULL AND "worker_attributes"."value_number" IS NULL AND "worker_attributes"."value_text_list" IS NULL) OR
        ("worker_attributes"."value_kind" = 'text_list' AND "worker_attributes"."value_text_list" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_attributes"."value_bool" IS NULL AND "worker_attributes"."value_number" IS NULL AND "worker_attributes"."value_text" IS NULL)
      )

wa_pack_pin_chk.name: wa_pack_pin_chk
wa_pack_pin_chk.value: ("worker_attributes"."pack_id" IS NULL AND "worker_attributes"."pack_version" IS NULL) OR ("worker_attributes"."pack_id" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_attributes"."pack_version" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_attributes"."pack_version" >= 1)

we_ym_format_chk.name: we_ym_format_chk
we_ym_format_chk.value: ("worker_employment"."start_ym" IS NULL OR "worker_employment"."start_ym" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$') AND ("worker_employment"."end_ym" IS NULL OR "worker_employment"."end_ym" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$')

we_ym_order_chk.name: we_ym_order_chk
we_ym_order_chk.value: "worker_employment"."start_ym" IS NULL OR "worker_employment"."end_ym" IS NULL OR "worker_employment"."end_ym" >= "worker_employment"."start_ym"

wer_ym_format_chk.name: wer_ym_format_chk
wer_ym_format_chk.value: ("worker_employment_role"."start_ym" IS NULL OR "worker_employment_role"."start_ym" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$') AND ("worker_employment_role"."end_ym" IS NULL OR "worker_employment_role"."end_ym" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$')

wer_ym_order_chk.name: wer_ym_order_chk
wer_ym_order_chk.value: "worker_employment_role"."start_ym" IS NULL OR "worker_employment_role"."end_ym" IS NULL OR "worker_employment_role"."end_ym" >= "worker_employment_role"."start_ym"

wed_not_empty_chk.name: wed_not_empty_chk
wed_not_empty_chk.value: "worker_education"."credential" IS NOT NULL OR "worker_education"."field" IS NOT NULL OR "worker_education"."council" IS NOT NULL OR "worker_education"."year" IS NOT NULL OR "worker_education"."institute" IS NOT NULL

worker_answers_one_value_chk.name: worker_answers_one_value_chk
worker_answers_one_value_chk.value:
(
        ("worker_answers"."answer_text" IS NOT NULL)::int +
        ("worker_answers"."answer_number" IS NOT NULL)::int +
        ("worker_answers"."answer_date" IS NOT NULL)::int
      ) = 1

worker_profiles_job_domain_match_layer_c.name: worker_profiles_job_domain_match_layer_chk
worker_profiles_job_domain_match_layer_c.value:
"worker_profiles"."job_domain_match_layer" IS NULL OR (
        "worker_profiles"."job_domain_match_layer" IN ('l0_exact', 'l1_skeleton', 'l2_trigram', 'l3_vector')
        AND "worker_profiles"."job_domain_match_status" LIKE 'matched%'
      )

applications_job_ref_chk.name: applications_job_ref_chk
applications_job_ref_chk.value: ("applications"."job_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("applications"."job_posting_id" IS NOT NULL)

applications_snapshot_months_nonneg_chk.name: applications_snapshot_months_nonneg_chk
applications_snapshot_months_nonneg_chk.value: ("applications"."skill_months" IS NULL OR "applications"."skill_months" >= 0) AND ("applications"."industry_months" IS NULL OR "applications"."industry_months" >= 0)

job_postings_pay_nonneg_chk.name: job_postings_pay_nonneg_chk
job_postings_pay_nonneg_chk.value: ("job_postings"."pay_min" IS NULL OR "job_postings"."pay_min" >= 0) AND ("job_postings"."pay_max" IS NULL OR "job_postings"."pay_max" >= 0)

job_postings_pay_order_chk.name: job_postings_pay_order_chk
job_postings_pay_order_chk.value: "job_postings"."pay_min" IS NULL OR "job_postings"."pay_max" IS NULL OR "job_postings"."pay_max" >= "job_postings"."pay_min"

jobs_pay_nonneg_chk.name: jobs_pay_nonneg_chk
jobs_pay_nonneg_chk.value: ("jobs"."pay_min" IS NULL OR "jobs"."pay_min" >= 0) AND ("jobs"."pay_max" IS NULL OR "jobs"."pay_max" >= 0)

jobs_pay_order_chk.name: jobs_pay_order_chk
jobs_pay_order_chk.value: "jobs"."pay_min" IS NULL OR "jobs"."pay_max" IS NULL OR "jobs"."pay_max" >= "jobs"."pay_min"

jobs_experience_nonneg_chk.name: jobs_experience_nonneg_chk
jobs_experience_nonneg_chk.value: ("jobs"."min_experience_years" IS NULL OR "jobs"."min_experience_years" >= 0) AND ("jobs"."max_experience_years" IS NULL OR "jobs"."max_experience_years" >= 0)

jobs_experience_order_chk.name: jobs_experience_order_chk
jobs_experience_order_chk.value: "jobs"."min_experience_years" IS NULL OR "jobs"."max_experience_years" IS NULL OR "jobs"."max_experience_years" >= "jobs"."min_experience_years"

referral_links_single_owner_chk.name: referral_links_single_owner_chk
referral_links_single_owner_chk.value: NOT ("referral_links"."agent_payer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "referral_links"."owner_worker_id" IS NOT NULL)

learn_labels_skip_reason_chk.name: learn_labels_skip_reason_chk
learn_labels_skip_reason_chk.value: ("learn_labels"."skip_reason" IS NULL AND "learn_labels"."outcome" <> 'skipped') OR ("learn_labels"."skip_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "learn_labels"."outcome" = 'skipped')
